purpose: Verified team context (roster changes, onboarding, results, head-to-head) used ONLY as a qualitative gate for the leaderboard (contrarian) pick. Context never changes a probability. Every entry carries the URL that was read and the UTC read time.

rule_types.roster_change: favourite changed players / IGL / coach within the last 120 days (onboarding risk)
rule_types.stand_in: favourite plays with a stand-in for this event
rule_types.rest_disadvantage: favourite played materially more recently / more maps than the underdog
rule_types.h2h_underdog_win: underdog has beaten this opponent in an official series within the last 12 months

Aurora.summary: Summer rebuild: kyxsan (ex-Falcons) signed as in-game leader, Jimpphat (ex-MOUZ) added and ash became head coach; MAJ3R, soulfly and coach Fabre left the active roster. The all-Turkish lineup became an international one (new IGL, new coach and a new communication language at the same time).
Aurora.confirmation_note: HLTV team page (read 2026-10-15 ~09:45Z) lists XANTARES, woxic, Jimpphat, kyxsan, Wicadia with coach ash. No newer (October) roster move appears there, so the July rebuild is the most recent verified change.

Aurora.summary: Coach ash, after the EWC opening loss to BIG: practice looked more promising than official matches; the team was still integrating a new system, communication and playing cultures.
Aurora.secondary_note: Secondary outlet summarising an HLTV interview; the original HLTV interview URL was not opened in this session. Shown as context only.

Aurora.summary: Lost 0-2 to 9z in the TWC 2026 Group A opener (Inferno 11-13, Nuke 1-13). HLTV called it a statement win against the fifth-ranked VRS team.

9z.summary: HLTV: 9z made the playoffs at PGL Astana and the IEM Cologne Major in the first half of 2026, beating MOUZ, Falcons and Vitality along the way.
Before TWC: group-stage exits at their last four events (EWC, BLAST Porto, FPG 3, EPL 24). Then beat Aurora 2-0 in the TWC opener; luchov 1.61 rating.

Falcons.summary: Beat Ninjas in Pyjamas 2-0 in TWC Group A.

Legacy.summary: Beat PARIVISION 2-0 in TWC Group B.

FURIA.summary: Beat BETBOOM 2-0 in TWC Group B.

PARIVISION.summary: Lost 0-2 to Legacy; plays BetBoom in a TWC elimination match.

BetBoom.summary: Lost 0-2 to FURIA; plays PARIVISION in a TWC elimination match.

event_facts.fact: Thunderpick World Championship 2026: 14-18 Oct 2026, Malta, $1,000,000, 8 teams.
Day 1 results: 9z 2-0 Aurora, Falcons 2-0 Ninjas in Pyjamas, Legacy 2-0 PARIVISION, FURIA 2-0 BETBOOM.

Day 2 schedule (HLTV, times shown in HLTV's viewer timezone UTC-4 at read time): 9z vs Falcons, PARIVISION vs BETBOOM, Legacy vs FURIA; Aurora vs Ninjas in Pyjamas was live at read time. HotSpawn lists the same three pairings at 11:00, 13:30 and 16:00 UTC.
